notes: Fixes the freeze that made Hangar need a restart. Writing to a terminal whose agent had stopped reading blocked the thread that serves the whole interface, with the lock every open terminal shares held — so every pane went silent at once. Measured before the fix: a single keystroke blocked for 31 seconds. And a background loop no longer dies for good on one panic, which was the other way a part of the app could stop until you reopened it.
